label: Diagram 3.11
caption: Diagram 3.11 Floating floors (a) and (b)
description:
The image is a section drawing, headed in a pale green band by the words "Diagram 3.11 Floating floors (a) and (b)". Two horizontal sections are stacked one above the other, each with a caption beneath it, and the word "SECTION" appears in the bottom right corner. No dimensions or scale are shown.

The upper section is captioned "Floating floor (a)". It depicts a long horizontal assembly whose base is a continuous resilient layer drawn as a wavy band. On this base sit three small square blocks, each cross‑hatched with two diagonals, spaced at intervals along the length. Above the blocks is a plain horizontal layer bounded by a solid line. At the left end is a short vertical resilient edge strip, drawn with the same wavy pattern.

The lower section is captioned "Floating floor (b)". It repeats the same resilient layer and edge strip. In place of the square blocks, its upper region contains small scattered mark symbols set against a dashed line.
